name: proofbundle
description: Verify decision and outcome receipts against a chosen issuer key, check evidence bundles, and separate verification results from recorded claims. Guard is a separate preview area and requires its hook configuration to be installed and active. Under Claude Code, recognized shell forms can check declared evidence; supported MCP writes ask because their target is unbound. Level 1 does not inspect arbitrary executed code. Verification checks authorship and integrity of recorded bytes, not whether the recorded values are true. Receipt signing is experimental; the emit skill requests explicit invocation and confirmation, but host enforcement is not measured.
